verdict.rationale: Handelsregister/Unternehmensregister is documented only as a publicly operated online portal for searching register entries, filings and announcements. Nothing in the evidence shows downloadable software, an open-source release, or any deployment option a user could run on their own infrastructure. Self-hosting is a fair question for an online register or data service, so the absence of evidence makes this "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
